company_name: Shanghai Hengxin metal product manufacturing Co.,Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides critical metal and graphite components used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai Hengxin Metal Products Manufacturing Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of tungsten and molybdenum metal parts, high-purity graphite, and precision custom components for ion implanters and etching equipment. With a focus on high-quality raw materials and advanced machining capabilities, the company serves leading domestic integrated circuit manufacturers and equipment suppliers.
capabilities: Production of tungsten and molybdenum parts for ion implanters
Precision custom parts for semiconductor equipment
Surface treatment technology for enhanced performance

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Baoshan District, Shanghai, and serves leading domestic integrated circuit manufacturers.
